claims.claim: OpenHandsExecutor adapter with fail-closed import probe and verified license provenance

verification_gates.description: openhands-sdk pinned with version-scoped license provenance
evidence: uv.lock: openhands-sdk 1.58.2, openhands-workspace 1.58.2, openhands-agent-server 1.49.5, agent-client-protocol 0.12.1; uv sync --locked passes

ci/licenses.py PROVENANCE_MANIFEST: MIT for the three openhands packages (LICENSE at upstream tag v1.58.2 in OpenHands/software-agent-sdk); Apache-2.0 for agent-client-protocol 0.12.1 (LICENSE in the wheel)
tests/conformance/test_license_provenance.py: verified pins accepted; unverified 1.59.0 and 1.58.0 rejected; every locked provenanced package has a record
PyPI JSON for all four packages has no license field, so provenance comes from the LICENSE files above, not metadata
